slides.headline: A CREATOR SHIPPED 4 EPISODES OF AN AI SITCOM PEOPLE WON'T STOP WATCHING
slides.body:
**Daria Zabnieva** built **Bad Cat**, a fully AI-generated sitcom, to **4 episodes** with fans already waiting for the next one.

**Zero** studio. **Zero** team.

slides.headline: 1) GENERATE CINEMATIC VIDEO FROM A TYPED SENTENCE
slides.body:
A clip that costs **$500** in a studio takes **90 seconds** and zero dollars in Kling.

Go to **klingai.com**, sign up free. Paste a sentence. A **5-second cinematic clip** appears.

slides.headline: 2) VOICE YOUR ENTIRE SHOW FOR FREE IN TWO MINUTES
slides.body:
A professional voice actor charges **$250 per hour**. ElevenLabs does the same job in **two minutes** for free.

Go to **elevenlabs.io**. You get **10,000 characters per month** at zero cost.

slides.headline: 3) MAKE ORIGINAL MUSIC IN 30 SECONDS
slides.body:
A custom track from a composer costs **$200 to $500**. Suno generates one from a sentence in **30 seconds** for free.

Go to **suno.com**. You get **10 songs per day**, no royalties owed.

slides.headline: 4) WRITE A FULL EPISODE SCRIPT FROM ONE SENTENCE
slides.body:
Claude writes a full episode script in **90 seconds** from one idea, free at **claude.ai**.

Paste your show's name and ask for characters, scene breakdown, and dialogue ready for a voice generator.

slides.headline: 5) ANIMATE ANY CHARACTER FROM A DESCRIPTION
slides.body:
Go to **pika.art**, sign up free. Describe your character, emotion, and movement. A **3-to-5-second animated clip** appears.

Stack these clips in any free video editor and you have a complete sequence.
